description: Documentation contract for the task-annotation-v1 pipeline artifacts. Machine enforcement lives in paper/scripts/validate-task-annotations.mjs; this file is the human-readable shape reference.

fields.inventoryStatus: string, pre-freeze-main56 — this is NOT a formal frozen benchmark snapshot; the 56-task snapshot is created by the research plan's QC process later
fields.inventoryCommit: string, full git SHA of main at inventory time; every source of the packet resolves from git objects at THIS commit
fields.annotationStatus: string, not-started | in-progress | single-pass-incomplete | complete — computed by the validator from the templates; 'adjudicating' is a workflow phase (guidelines §8), not a storable status: while adjudication is open the status stays in-progress
fields.tasks: array of {id, interactionMode: Static|Hands-on, treeSha} — exactly the benchmark/tasks/ directories at inventoryCommit, lexical order; interactionMode machine-derived from the pinned README Type column

rules: tasks must exactly equal git ls-tree <inventoryCommit>:benchmark/tasks/ — no missing, extra, or duplicate entries
interactionMode must equal the benchmark/README.md Type column at inventoryCommit (never the ID prefix)
a task that is hard to classify is never dropped; it is annotated unresolved with rationale and confidence=low

fields.annotationStatus: string, copied from inventory.annotationStatus at generation time
fields.taskCount: number, must equal inventory task count
fields.tasks: array of per-task evidence objects: {taskId, interactionMode, taskTreeSha, taskToml: {name, version, description, keywords}, instruction: full pinned instruction.md text, readme: {summary, environment, verifier} paragraphs pinned and outcome-scrubbed, fixtureFiles: relative paths pinned, referencedCards: [{cardId, source, text}] pinned, unresolvedCardRefs: [cardId] referenced by the instruction but not found in the pinned references corpus}

leakageRules: no benchmark/results/ source path may appear anywhere
no field may be named reward/score/delta/activation*
no outcome phrase may appear: mean reward, median reward, expected reward, reward.txt, with-skill, no-skill, no-injected-skill, activation rate, skill delta
no model id (deepseek-v4-flash, gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.6-terra, claude, codex, terminus) may appear
no exposure-ledger or holdout verdict vocabulary: clean-holdout, mixed (as verdict), ineligible, knowledge_holdout_v1, provisional_role, development-vs-holdout
the word "meaning" is not an outcome word and must not false-positive
determinism: regeneration from the same inventoryCommit is byte-identical: no timestamps, host paths, usernames, or nondeterministic ordering
task ordering is lexical by task id

rules: task_id rows are pre-filled with the full inventory so no task can be silently omitted
difficulty: blank in v1 (deferred to P1)
same incident_family_id requires identical family_short_name across all rows of one annotator
a CSV with all label fields blank is status not-started (valid); any partially filled CSV is incomplete (invalid)
annotator_id and the independence declaration are required as soon as any row is filled
only tasks listed as disagreements may be adjudicated
choice: A | B | new; new requires chosen_family_id and/or chosen_trap_type plus a reason
the adjudicator is a third party: its id must differ from both annotator ids; the role is adjudicator, never "annotator C"

fields.status: string, complete | incomplete — incomplete when any required submission is missing; no pseudo-metrics are computed in that case

consensus.file: consensus.csv — MUST NOT EXIST until adjudication completes; this pipeline never fabricates consensus
consensus.joinKey: task_id — the only join key to task-exposure-ledger.csv and temporal-holdout-v1; exposure status and holdout eligibility are NOT annotation inputs
